narrative.overview: This is an extension of the incumbent world, not a new identity. `app/layout.tsx` imports `globals.css`, then the pre-existing `white-theme.css`, then scoped `workspace-refresh.css`. The later white-theme tokens are authoritative; the frontmatter records their effective values. A light curtain, transparent light navigation rail, blue actions and white task fields define the shipped world. The approved reconstruction covers app navigation, courses, papers, data, projects and settings. Original overview body, public landing and authentication remain outside this reconstruction; PRODUCT.md and product, data, accessibility and semantic contracts remain unchanged. See `docs/releases/2026-10-12-workspace-redesign.md` for scope and recoverable original code.
keyCharacteristics: Light curtain and cool workspace; transparent light navigation rail and white task fields. Deep navy remains a token for genuinely inverse regions, not a navigation requirement.
One accent (brand blue) for the whole product; one reserved semantic accent (AI teal).
Paper now uses the incumbent white `--surface-paper`; the earlier warm-paper material description is retained as superseded history.
System sans throughout; Georgia has been removed from page-level titles.
Page structure carries no elevation at all: full-bleed rule-separated bands hold the chrome, and the capped measure sits inside them.
A scholarly surface holds structure with rules, alignment and paper material instead: two clearly bounded premium surfaces is its guideline ceiling.
Borders plus the lightest shadow carry structure for controls and genuinely raised content; a page is never a stack of floating cards.
A numeric register reports the page's real state, and the dense tool surfaces are allowed to look like instruments rather than like marketing panels.
A surface never prints a number it has not read: unknown is `—`, never `0`.
Motion is restrained and always explains a state change.

rules.name: The Uneven Density Rule
rules.body: Unified language, not unified structure; the approved task fields retain each tool’s density.

rules.name: The Unknown Is Not Zero Rule
rules.body: Unread values are unknown, never zero; failed, unread and empty states remain distinct.

dos: Do retain visible keyboard focus and all existing product, data and semantic contracts.
Do use PageHeader and each workspace’s actual task layout.
donts: Don’t introduce route waits, continuous motion loops or scroll hijacking.
Don’t copy dashboard composition across tool workspaces.
Don’t canonize pre-existing out-of-scope visual drift.
